title: Electricity net imports as % of net consumption (EIA, derived)

indicator.name: Electricity net imports (% of net consumption)
indicator.description: 100 × (electricity imports − electricity exports) ÷ electricity net consumption, same country and year, all three in BKWH (billion kilowatt-hours) from EIA. Positive = share of consumption covered by net imports; negative = net exporter.

source.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), International Energy Statistics
source.license: Public domain (U.S. Government data); EIA asks to be credited as the source
source.citation: Derived from U.S. EIA International Energy Statistics exports "electricity-imports-SeriesExport-10-12-2026-18-32-26.json", "electricity-exports-SeriesExport-10-12-2026-18-32-54.json" and "net-electric-consumption-SeriesExport-10-12-2026-18-31-43.json".

notes: Computed by npm run data:import: for each entity, the latest year in which imports, exports and net consumption all have a number and consumption is above 0. Entities with no such year are kept as missing.

This is the only import-dependence share these EIA exports support: electricity is the only fuel with both trade and consumption in the same unit. Crude oil, natural gas, LPG and coal have no consumption series here.
caveats: Covers grid electricity only. A country that generates its own power from imported fuel (e.g. Japan or South Korea with imported LNG and coal) shows close to 0 here, so this is not overall energy dependence.
Net consumption excludes transmission and distribution losses, so for small systems that import most of their power net imports can exceed 100% of net consumption (e.g. Lesotho).

scoring.rationale: A real import-dependence share (0–100, net exporters ≤ 0), but for grid electricity only: it rates countries that burn imported fuel at home (Japan, South Korea) near 0. The scored Fuel & energy indicator is the electricity import exposure (Ember/EI via OWID), which already contains the direct net-import part, so this EIA series is kept as a cross-check and not scored (scoring both would double count). Set scoring.include to true in data/sources/eia-electricity-net-import-share.derived.json to score it anyway.
